shared_elements: human face / human figures rendered schematically
justification: The only shared content is the human form: A is a single three-dimensional head with brow, eyes, nose and lips carved in relief, while B is a flat linear composition dominated by large boats with crew-strokes, accompanied by tiny stick figures and animals. There is no shared motif, relationship or arrangement, and the depictive conventions (volumetric frontal portrait versus schematic outline drawing of vessels) are entirely different.
